attributes.context: The text is the body of Article 38, titled 'ON-BOARD RECORDING DEVICE,' in the supplied CBA text; adjacent articles cover unrelated topics such as passengers, fueling, cleaning, shop access, job evaluations, and disciplinary procedures.

extraction_text:
The Company reserves the right to use On-Board recording devices in the trucks. Because driver proficiency with such devices is expected from the employees, the Company is obligated to keep this equipment in good working order, and to continuously provide up to date and necessary training to all drivers in the use of such equipment.

A recording is only marked and downloaded by the Company when it is triggered by these unusual events: accident, hard braking, hard acceleration, swerving or other significant irregular movement, or when manually triggered by the driver.

The parties have been unable to agree on the terms of the Company's implementation of the SmartDrive© system, so the Company agrees it will take no disciplinary action during the term of this 2018 Agreement against any driver based solely on information received by the Company from SmartDrive©. The Union reserves all rights.
